text: In order for a relationship to work out, the guy needs to love the girl more. Again, in order... Yeah, I heard you the first time. And no, in order for a relationship to work out, the guy shouldn't love the girl more. In order for a relationship to work out, you need to choose someone who is actually suited for a relationship. And in today's world, that's not an easy task. There's an old saying, no matter how much you straighten a bent wheel, it will never roll straight. If you think you can take someone who has no emotional maturity, no stability, no healthy habits, no accountability, no boundaries, and magically love them into being a partner, wake up. This isn't a pretty woman. You are not Richard Gere, and she is not Julia Roberts. This is a real life. People don't reinvent their entire value system because someone loves them harder. And yes, this goes both ways. There are men who are not suited for healthy relationships, just like there are women who aren't. A shaky foundation doesn't become solid because someone tries harder. The real formula for a working relationship is choosing a partner with the right qualities. Empathy, consistency, respect, accountability, emotional maturity, teamwork, effort, and reciprocity. Someone whose presence makes your life better, not heavier. Someone who meets you in the middle, not someone you have to carry.
